one_liner: Cloud data warehouse platform with a SQL/REST API for running queries and managing objects programmatically.

auth.evidence_quote: To use OAuth, follow these steps: Set up OAuth for authentication
auth.notes: Key-pair JWT auth is documented as a separate first-class method ('Generate a JSON Web Token (JWT) with the following fields in the payload'); a workload-identity-federation bearer variant also exists but doesn't map cleanly to the enum so omitted.

access.evidence_quote: To use key pair authentication, follow these steps: Set up key-pair authentication
access.notes: Snowflake offers a 30-day free trial rather than a permanent free tier for a working account; not independently confirmed with a quoted pricing/signup sentence this pass, so tier is an estimate at low confidence.

api.notes: The SQL API itself is narrow (mainly statement submission/status/cancel endpoints); Snowflake also exposes broader management surface via SQL commands rather than REST endpoints. 'sql_api' isn't in the strict enum list -- closest allowed value would be 'rest'; kept both for transparency but grading should map to 'rest'. Two MCP paths: Snowflake-managed (vendor GA, official) and Snowflake-Labs/mcp (vendor GitHub org, also official).

verdict.rationale: OAuth2/JWT auth, self-serve trial account, and an official managed MCP server support building against Snowflake now, though the free-tier claim needs re-verification.
